stories.article_text_excerpt: PARIS — French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez on Friday summoned a senior civil servant who is under judicial investigation for allegedly leaking confidential information to the far-right National Rally. Hugues Moutouh, the senior state representative in the Centre-Val de Loire region, is under investigation by prosecutors in Paris for reportedly passing on information about judicial investigations into Marine Le Pen’s party, according to multiple French outlets including Le Monde, which first reported on the allegations . The investigation was opened in July and Moutouh has not been formally charged, Le Monde reported. Civil servants are bound by professional confidentiality, and sharing information on a judicial investigation is also an offense under French law. Advertisement Advertisement On Friday, Nuñez confirmed that Moutouh was being investigated but said he was not informed of the details of the inquiry. “If the allegations are verified, they are obviously very serious,” Nuñez told BFMTV. The interior minister also said he would see Moutouh on Friday morning. Moutouh could not be directly reached for comment. His office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
